_meta: Scaled non-math policy faithfulness corpus for certify_policy_faithfulness (goal item 3). Each case: a TRUSTED intent rule + a candidate formalization over an integer/bool domain (z3 SmtPolicyChecker syntax: And/Or/Not, ==,>=,>,<=,<). truth_equivalent is the GROUND TRUTH (z3 is the actual decider at runtime; this is the expected verdict). class = faithful | laundered. The engine returns CERTIFIED (faithful) or REFUTED (laundered, with a re-verifiable distinguishing input) — an artifact, never an opinion. Domains span compliance/finance/access/eligibility.

cases.label: basel_car_reorder
cases.domain: Basel capital adequacy: adequate iff CET1 ratio >= 7 (bp/100) AND total capital >= 105 (×10), OR a systemic waiver flag.

cases.label: basel_car_cet1_offby
cases.domain: Basel: same, candidate weakens the CET1 floor 7→6.

cases.label: regt_margin_boundary
cases.domain: Reg-T initial margin: call iff equity < 50% of market value; here call iff 2*equity < mktval.

cases.label: regt_margin_strict_launder
cases.domain: Reg-T: candidate flips strict< to <= (admits the exact-50% boundary that should NOT call).

cases.label: tax_bracket_cliff
cases.domain: Tax cliff: higher rate iff income > 100 (×1000). Candidate uses >= (taxes the exact 100k boundary).

cases.label: hipaa_access_faithful
cases.domain: HIPAA access: permit iff (treating provider) OR (patient consent AND not restricted).
cases.intent: Or(is_provider == True, And(consent == True, restricted == False))
cases.candidate: Or(And(Not(restricted == True), consent == True), is_provider == True)

cases.label: hipaa_drop_restriction_launder
cases.domain: HIPAA: candidate drops the 'not restricted' guard (leaks restricted records on consent).
cases.intent: Or(is_provider == True, And(consent == True, restricted == False))

cases.label: aviation_duty_time
cases.domain: Aviation: rest required iff duty hours >= 14 OR sectors flown >= 6.

cases.label: aviation_sector_offby_launder
cases.domain: Aviation: candidate raises the sector floor 6→7 (skips rest after 6 sectors).

cases.label: export_control_clauses
cases.domain: Export control: deny iff (dual_use AND destination_embargoed) OR entity_listed.
cases.intent: Or(And(dual_use == True, embargoed == True), listed == True)
cases.candidate: Or(listed == True, And(embargoed == True, dual_use == True))

cases.label: export_and_to_or_launder
cases.domain: Export control: candidate turns the AND into OR (denies any dual-use regardless of destination).
cases.intent: Or(And(dual_use == True, embargoed == True), listed == True)
cases.candidate: Or(Or(dual_use == True, embargoed == True), listed == True)

cases.label: aml_threshold_faithful
cases.domain: AML: report iff amount >= 10000 OR (structuring flag AND amount >= 3000).

cases.label: aml_structuring_floor_launder
cases.domain: AML: candidate raises the structuring floor 3000→5000 (misses 3–5k structured transfers).

cases.label: loan_eligibility_faithful
cases.domain: Loan: approve iff age >= 18 AND score >= 680 AND (income >= 50 OR cosigner).

cases.label: loan_score_offby_launder
cases.domain: Loan: candidate lowers the score floor 680→670.

cases.label: gdpr_lawful_basis_faithful
cases.domain: GDPR processing: lawful iff consent OR contract OR legitimate_interest (and not a minor without parental consent).
cases.intent: And(Or(Or(consent == True, contract == True), legit == True), Or(minor == False, parental == True))
cases.candidate: And(Or(minor == False, parental == True), Or(consent == True, Or(contract == True, legit == True)))

cases.label: gdpr_drop_minor_guard_launder
cases.domain: GDPR: candidate drops the minor/parental guard (processes minors' data without parental consent).
cases.intent: And(Or(Or(consent == True, contract == True), legit == True), Or(minor == False, parental == True))
cases.candidate: Or(Or(consent == True, contract == True), legit == True)
